script: Did you know there was a game that was played 3 vs 5? You see, back in 2017, a fight broke out during this college basketball game. And during this fight, the Alabama bench came onto the court to defend their teammate, but leaving the bench meant they broke a rule, and they would all get ejected. And this left Alabama with just 5 players available on the team. However, a minute later, Alabama would go down to 4 men as someone would foul out. And if things couldn't get worse, an Alabama player gets injured, meaning there were only 3 players remaining. Now it's a 3v5, and Alabama is down 15 points. But out of nowhere, Collin Sexton starts hitting every shot he takes, bringing his team closer and closer. But sadly it wasn't enough, even though they outscored Minnesota with just 3 players.
